lessons.briefing: In professional workshop practice, mastering Cyber Law and Ethics in Kenya: Computer Misuse and Cybercrimes Act 2018, Data Protection Act 2019, Professional Ethics requires strict adherence to safety standards and sequential execution. Always inspect personal protective equipment (PPE), ensure proper tool calibration, and verify that the workpiece is securely mounted before commencing. Observe manufacturer specifications and relevant standards. Maintain a clean work environment, store consumables dry, and double-check your alignment.
lessons.briefingSw: Katika mazoezi ya warsha, kuelewa Cyber Law and Ethics in Kenya: Computer Misuse and Cybercrimes Act 2018, Data Protection Act 2019, Professional Ethics kunahitaji kufuata sheria za usalama na mpangilio sahihi. Kagua vifaa vya kujikinga (PPE) kabla ya kuanza kazi.
